summary.text: Heath Flora is a Republican member of the California State Assembly from District 9 who took office on December 5, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and small business owner who volunteered as a firefighter for 15 years, he served as Assembly minority leader from September 2025 until August 2026.

paragraphs.text: Heath Flora was born in and lives in Modesto, California.
His career experience includes working as a farmer and a small business owner, and he volunteered as a firefighter for 15 years.
Ballotpedia lists Flora as serving on Assembly committees in the 2017 legislative session, indicating service in the chamber before the term that began in 2022.
He was re-elected on November 5, 2024, defeating Tami Nobriga of the American Independent Party of California, 70.1 percent to 29.9 percent.
In the six-candidate June 2, 2026 primary he received 30.6 percent and advanced to the general election against Democrat Matthew Adams.
For 2025 and 2026 he was vice chair of the Budget, Business and Professions, and Labor and Employment committees and a member of the Health, Natural Resources and Rules committees.
